component.title: Resizable Panel
component.purpose: One behavior owner for every resizable region: pointer, keyboard, bounds, snapping, collapse and persistence.

states.description: A bounded inline-axis panel reporting its size as a sentence.
Every reachable size is reachable from the keyboard.
An injected storage adapter seeds and receives the committed size.

claims.statement: Arrows step by a declared pixel amount, Shift coarsens, Home and End reach the bounds, PageUp and PageDown move between snap points, Enter restores the default.
Axis and edge are logical, so the same configuration resizes correctly under dir=rtl and on the block axis.
The live drag writes one custom property and commits to React state once on release, so the rendered dimension has exactly one writer.
Persistence goes through an injectable adapter; the localStorage default is a fallback, not a requirement.
The pointer path is exercised by unit tests rather than by these stories, because the story runner has no pointer-drag interaction kind.
